name: DM02a: Newly Diagnosed Diabetes Mellitus
description:
Number of clients active on ART who were newly diagnosed with Diabetes Mellitus during the reporting quarter.
The patient must have a DM status recorded during the reporting quarter indicating either Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification or Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification and Medication. The patient must satisfy the active-care rule. These statuses are explicitly available under the Diabetes Mellitus Status concept.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.diabetes_mellitus_status IN (
      'Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification',
      'Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification and Medication'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
